plainName: Protect the puck from a chaser
description: Skaters pair up with one puck between them. The rabbit has the puck and skates anywhere on the ice; the coyote chases and tries to take it. After a short burst, blow the whistle, rest for 30 seconds and switch roles.
steps: On the whistle, the rabbit carries the puck anywhere on the ice.
The coyote chases and tries to take the puck.
Second whistle: rest 30 seconds, then switch.
cues: Keep your body between the coyote and the puck.

focus.why: Shielding the puck with the body while moving.
Heads up to find space and avoid traffic.

source.label: Hockey Canada U9 Plan 10 · skill 5.1.4.1
source.note: The source doesn't say how long each burst lasts; keep it short (about 20–30 seconds) so the rest matches the work. Pairs use the whole ice.
